notes: Real plate: baked/blackened salmon, white rice, roasted asparagus, dinner roll — well-lit, single plate, foods clearly visible; verify must stay quiet. Ground truth uses the real asparagus and dinner-roll entries (added to foodDb 2026-08-06); the old green-beans / bread-whole-wheat proxies are gone. Note the missing dinner-roll entry also caused a WRONG match, not just a missing one: matchFood('Dinner roll') resolved to rolled oats, because 'rolled' starts with 'roll' — that inflated a detected id that was never on the plate and cost precision. Servings approximate the app's own prior real analysis of this exact meal (46g protein / 62g carbs / 22g fat / 620 kcal). SOURCE NOTE: this file is an app screenshot (status bar + confirm-screen UI chrome baked into the pixels), not a clean raw camera capture — replace with a real un-cropped device photo when the team adds one.

Real photo: staff lunch tray, 4 meatballs in marinara over rice, mashed potato and sauteed pepper/onion sides. Well-lit, distinct compartments; verify must stay quiet. Ground truth uses the real meatballs / mashed-potato / onion / marinara entries (added to foodDb 2026-08-06) instead of the old ground-beef-90 / whole-potato / bell-pepper-only proxies, which counted no binder, no sauce, and no added fat. 4 meatballs = 1.33 of the 3-meatball serving.

Real photo: to-go container, sliced braised/roasted beef in its own jus, roasted potato wedges, green beans. Well-lit, single well-separated compartment, foods clearly visible; verify must stay quiet. FOOD_DB has no braised-beef entry, so sirloin-steak stands in (closest protein; the real dish is fattier/moister with pan jus, so this proxy likely undercounts fat and total kcal a bit).

Real photo: plated dinner, saucy chicken chunks, sliced beef in gravy, cooked collard greens, white rice. Well-lit, foods distinct; verify must stay quiet. Ground truth uses the real collard-greens entry (added to foodDb 2026-08-06: 1 cup cooked at 70 kcal / 3g fat, reflecting greens simmered with fat rather than raw leaf). The old spinach proxy priced a whole cup of collards at 7 kcal, which is what made this case's kcal/fat ground truth a floor rather than a value.

Real photo: scrambled eggs, 3 bacon strips, 2 breakfast-sausage links, cheddar grits, side of grapes. Well-lit, foods clearly visible; verify must stay quiet. Ground truth now COUNTS the bacon and sausage (entries added to foodDb 2026-08-06). Previously both were excluded entirely — roughly half the plate's calories had no ground-truth representation, so a model that reported them honestly scored WORSE on macro error than one that under-reported. Grits has its own entry now instead of the oats proxy. Caveat that remains: matchFood maps one detected item to one food id, so a single 'cheddar grits' detection resolves to cheddar and grits recall depends on the model naming the two separately.

Real photo: 2 open-face loaded soft tacos (restaurant/prepared-meal style) — shredded beef, chicken chunks, rice, shredded lettuce, shredded cheddar, sour cream, pico, on flour tortillas. Well-lit, busy but legible; verify must stay quiet. Ground truth now counts the sour cream and pico (sour-cream + salsa entries added to foodDb 2026-08-06); both were previously uncounted. mixed-greens (alias 'lettuce') still proxies the shredded lettuce. First 'restaurant' caseType in the set.
